customPrompt:
⚠ CRITICAL RULE — READ FIRST BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE:
This is a TWO-PERSON GROUP PHOTO task. The final image MUST contain EXACTLY TWO distinct people with TWO COMPLETELY DIFFERENT FACES.
DO NOT face-swap. DO NOT replace the footballer's face. DO NOT apply Image 2's face onto the person in Image 1.
The footballer in Image 1 is PERSON A — he stays 100% unchanged, pixel-perfect, face and all.
The person in Image 2 is PERSON B — a brand-new second individual ADDED to the scene standing next to PERSON A.
If the output shows only one person, or shows PERSON A's body with PERSON B's face, the task has FAILED.

Image 1: Base scene — a professional football stadium pitch-side photograph taken at eye-level to slightly low, positioned at pitch level. Full-body vertical portrait framing. PERSON A: a male footballer in a red/maroon Galatasaray-style Puma long-sleeve training top (yellow/orange shoulder and sleeve panel trim), matching red/maroon shorts with Galatasaray crest near the hem, white crew socks with black Puma logo, white athletic sneakers/trainers. Standing upright on the green grass pitch in a relaxed pre-match or warm-up stance: left hand tucked in jacket pocket, right hand holding a mate-style drinking cup with metal straw at chest height, a thermos/flask tucked under the right arm. White/light gray over-ear headphones hanging around the neck. Neutral to focused expression, mouth closed, gaze directed slightly off-camera toward viewer's left/across the field. Tattooing visible on the right hand and on the lower right leg. Background: rows of blurred red stadium seats, blurred spectators in red/yellow/black/white tones, white and red pitch-side advertising barrier behind the player — all strongly blurred by shallow depth of field.

Image 2: Identity reference for PERSON B only — extract the face, body proportions, and physical appearance of this person. They will be added as a SECOND person standing next to PERSON A.

Instruction:
Place PERSON B standing directly next to PERSON A, on his right side (viewer's left), on the same green grass pitch — as if both are standing together at pitch-side during the same warm-up or pre-match arrival moment.

PERSON A — ZERO MODIFICATIONS:
- His face, build, skin tone, expression, gaze: unchanged
- His full-body pose, relaxed stance, mate cup and thermos in right hand, headphones around neck, left hand in pocket: unchanged
- Tattoos on right hand and lower right leg: do not alter or remove
- His red/maroon Puma long-sleeve training top, shorts, socks, shoes: unchanged
- Full-body framing showing feet and pitch surface: unchanged
- Red stadium seating background blur, advertising barrier, spectators: unchanged
- Do not alter a single pixel of his appearance or the scene

PERSON B — FACE (the single most critical requirement — zero tolerance for deviation):
⚠ Image 2 contains a PHOTOGRAPH of a real person's face. You must COPY this photograph directly — do NOT generate a new face, do NOT render a generic or averaged face, do NOT use Image 2 merely as a loose reference. Treat it as a face transplant: the exact face from the photograph must appear on PERSON B's body with no alterations whatsoever.
- Face shape, skull structure, forehead height, jawline, chin: exact copy from Image 2 — not similar, IDENTICAL
- Eyes: exact shape, color, spacing, eyelid fold, brow thickness and arch — copied from Image 2 pixel-accurately
- Nose: exact shape, width, bridge height, nostril shape — copied from Image 2
- Mouth and lips: exact shape, thickness, and proportions — copied from Image 2
- Skin tone and texture: exact match including any blemishes, marks, or asymmetries — do not smooth, lighten, darken, or idealize even slightly
- Hair: exact style, color, density, part, and hairline — copied from Image 2
- Beard/stubble: exact coverage, density, color, and growth pattern — copied from Image 2 if present
- Facial asymmetry: preserve any natural asymmetry — do not correct or balance the face
- Age markers: preserve all visible age lines, wrinkles, or features — do not rejuvenate
- DO NOT generate a new face. DO NOT average the face. DO NOT idealize. DO NOT beautify.
- If Image 2's face is not reproduced with full photographic accuracy, the task has FAILED.
- A viewer who knows the person in Image 2 must be able to identify them instantly in the output

PERSON B — KIT (exact copy of PERSON A's training wear, no improvisation):
- Top: identical red/maroon long-sleeve Puma training top with yellow/orange shoulder and sleeve panel trim — same hue, panel position, and trim width as PERSON A
- Puma logo: same gold/white Puma logo on same chest position as PERSON A
- Galatasaray G/S crest: placed on the chest — with EXACTLY 5 STARS above it. Not 3 stars. Not 4 stars. Exactly 5 stars. The crest shape must be accurate — do not distort, blur, or invent the badge. The 5 stars must be clearly visible, evenly spaced, and correctly rendered above the crest.
- Shorts: matching red/maroon shorts with Galatasaray G/S crest — again with exactly 5 stars — same as PERSON A
- Socks: white crew socks with black Puma logo
- Shoes: white athletic sneakers/trainers consistent with Image 1
- The kit must look physically worn — natural fabric folds, long sleeve drape, yellow/orange trim panels catching soft daylight, not a flat overlay
- Every logo and badge must be legible and correctly rendered — no blurred, distorted, or invented graphics

PERSON B — Pose and gaze:
- PERSON B must NOT look directly into the camera
- Body and gaze naturally motivated by the scene: relaxed pitch-side warm-up or pre-match arrival, candid atmosphere
- Standing upright in a relaxed stance beside PERSON A, head slightly turned toward him or toward the pitch/field
- Gaze directed slightly off-camera, across the field, or toward the stadium stands — matching PERSON A's own off-camera look
- Hands naturally relaxed: one hand loosely at side or in pocket, the other resting naturally
- Expression: neutral to focused, calm — matching the concentrated pre-match atmosphere, not smiling for a camera
- Body language reads as "this person belongs in this warm-up moment" not "this person was inserted into this photo"

Composition and scene:
- Both people stand on the same green grass pitch at the same depth and scale
- Camera angle: eye-level to slightly low, pitch level, full-body vertical framing — both subjects visible head to toe
- Background: same blurred red stadium seating, blurred spectators in red/yellow/black/white, white/red pitch-side advertising barrier — all consistently blurred behind both subjects
- Scale: both appear roughly the same height and distance from camera, standing on the same ground plane
- Depth of field: shallow to moderate — both subjects sharp, stadium background remains blurred at the same level as Image 1
- Resolution feel: composite must match the soft, low-to-medium resolution character of Image 1 — avoid making PERSON B appear hyper-sharp or over-detailed relative to PERSON A

Lighting for PERSON B:
- Bright outdoor or stadium daylight-balanced lighting, soft front and overhead direction with no harsh single-source shadows
- Neutral to slightly cool color temperature, moderate contrast — subject clearly separated from the red stadium background
- Cast shadows consistent with the same lighting source as PERSON A
- Yellow/orange trim panels catching soft daylight the same way as PERSON A's top

Final quality constraints:
- The result must look like both people were photographed together in the same single frame at pitch-side — not composited
- No watermarks. No FOTOTARENA text. No %100 overlay graphic. No floating artifacts. No seam lines between the two people
- Both subjects must appear to be standing on the same physical green pitch ground plane
- No distorted faces, hands, logos, or badge graphics
- Photorealistic sports editorial quality consistent with the source image's resolution and style
